This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every 
 three years as indicated by Y3 in the title block.

This 
 disconnect switch is outdoor in the switchyard. It's air disconnect switch. The 
 rated voltage 145KV. The rated current 3150 &1250 A and the short circuit 
 current 31.5 KA.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, accepted by 
 general Director eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh , and approved by eng . Mohamed Abdel 
 Basest head Sector of Aswan Dam 2 Hydraulic Power Station and certified by eng. 
 Kamel Ragheb: HPGC MPIS coordinator.

A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category

Wear your 
 safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety belt when cleaning suspension 
 insulator.

items:

 shoes, safety 
 belt etc.

Dry and fine 
 cloth, set of common keys, screw drivers, and blower

Remove dust 
 from disconnectswitch parts and mechanism cabinet.

Check 
 insulators with regard to damage.

Grease all 
 rotating points actuating the auxiliary switch. Measure the opening closing 
 time

Grease the 
 chains lightly with first class oil.

Grease the 
 bearings of vertical drive rods and coupling rods.

Clean the 
 main contacts with transformer oil and rub the contact surface with dry cloth

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every 
 three years as indicated by Y3 in the title block.
This 
 disconnect switch is outdoor in the switchyard. It's air disconnect switch. The 
 rated voltage 145KV. The rated current 3150 &1250 A and the short circuit 
 current 31.5 KA.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, accepted by 
 general Director eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh , and approved by eng . Mohamed Abdel 
 Basest head Sector of Aswan Dam 2 Hydraulic Power Station and certified by eng. 
 Kamel Ragheb: HPGC MPIS coordinator.
A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
Wear your 
 safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety belt when cleaning suspension 
 insulator.

 shoes, safety 
 belt etc.
Dry and fine 
 cloth, set of common keys, screw drivers, and blower
Grease and 
 graphite oil,
Portable earth for 
 discharging.
Voltage indicator and 
 ladder.
Work to be carried out
Remove dust 
 from disconnectswitch parts and mechanism cabinet.
Clean all 
 porcelain surfaces.
Check 
 insulators with regard to damage.
Grease all 
 rotating points actuating the auxiliary switch. Measure the opening closing 
 time
Grease the 
 chains lightly with first class oil.
Grease the 
 main bearings.
Grease the 
 bearings of vertical drive rods and coupling rods.
